trust_decision.summary: At the pinned commit every generated frontend hands the user-supplied blob content type straight to `new Blob([...], { type: contentType })` and opens that same-origin blob: URL in a new window, so a stored text/html or image/svg+xml blob executes script on the application origin; the fix decides, in one shared helper, that only whitelisted image/* and text/plain stay inline and every other type (all +xml included) is opened as application/octet-stream, then threads a blobType argument through the three framework wrappers and their screens.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'Unrestricted Blob ContentType Opened as Same-Origin Blob'; grepping openFile/createObjectURL leads to the single function that builds the Blob from the stored content type and calls globalThis.open on the object URL, and every Angular/React/Vue screen routes through it (or through the react-jhipster equivalent).

fix_sites.entry_point: generated app/shared/jhipster/data-utils.ts openFile(data, contentType, blobType) — the helper all three frontends import
Angular injectable DataUtils.openFile, used by the entity detail/list/update components
Angular entity detail screen component's openFile (clicked in _entityFile_-detail.html.ejs:52)
Angular /entity/<name>/:id detail page, clickable image blob
Angular entity list screen component's openFile
Angular /entity/<name> list page, clickable image blob
Angular /entity/<name>/:id/edit screen component's openFile (any-type blob link at _entityFile_-update.html.ejs:69)
React /entity/<name>/:id detail page: openFile re-pointed from react-jhipster to the local util and called lazily with (data, contentType, 'image')
React /entity/<name> list page: same import swap and argument-order change
Vue /entity/<name>/:id details page, clickable image blob
Vue /entity/<name> list page, clickable image blob
Vue useDataUtils().openFile composable method used by the details/list/update views

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The React screens' open action is not implemented in this repository at all: it is react-jhipster 1.0.3's own openFile, a different implementation with a different (contentType, data) argument order, so a solver who patches the shared data-utils template and the Angular/Vue wrappers can reasonably say the React path is a third-party package's problem.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate blobs must still open inline where they are meant to: an image field's thumbnail link must keep opening image/png as image/png (the fix's own new test asserts exactly that) and a text/plain blob must keep opening as text, while the inline data: preview next to the link keeps rendering. A fix that forces application/octet-stream everywhere, or that starts sanitising/whitelisting the stored contentType server-side, breaks image preview and text viewing of existing data.

O6_input_shapes: content type with parameters, e.g. 'text/html; charset=utf-8' (split on ';' before matching, fix.diff:215)
structured XML suffixes such as image/svg+xml or application/xhtml+xml (endsWith('+xml') always downgrades, fix.diff:216-218)
the blob-kind argument itself: 'image', 'text', 'any' or omitted (BlobType union, fix.diff:204,228)

O7_producer.where: generators/angular/templates/src/main/webapp/app/core/util/data-util.service.ts.ejs:63-95 (loadFileToForm writes file.type into <field>ContentType) and generators/vue/templates/src/main/webapp/app/shared/data/data-utils.service.ts.ejs:67-78 (setFileData does the same); the value is then persisted server-side and re-read with the entity, and the generated edit form even round-trips it through a hidden form control at generators/angular/templates/src/main/webapp/app/entities/_entityFolder_/update/_entityFile_-update.html.ejs:106-107

O8_uncovered_routes.route: React entity create/edit form's 'open' action for a non-image binary field is rendered by react-jhipster's ValidatedField via openActionLabel, i.e. it still calls the library's own unsafe openFile and never reaches the fixed helper
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The open action is a prop of a third-party component from react-jhipster; nothing in this repository builds that blob, so a solver argues the edit form is the library's responsibility and the advisory named the detail/list screens.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: generators/react package (the same package as the two React fix sites, but a different template file from them, and two packages away from generators/client/generators/common)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Vue useDataUtils().downloadFile builds a Blob with the raw stored contentType and hands it to an <a download> link — the same blob-construction primitive, untouched by the fix
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a download helper: tempLink.download is set, so the blob is saved rather than rendered, and no generated template calls it — easy to call it a non-sink and move on.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the fixed Vue openFile wrapper (0 package hops), so it is a weak route

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A 'previewFile(contentType, data)' composable helper next to downloadFile that reuses the same blob code without the download attribute
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The file already contains a verbatim clone of the blob-construction block (atob -> Uint8Array -> new Blob({type: contentType}) -> createObjectURL); a maintainer adding any new way to show a stored blob would copy that block, and only the fixed shared helper has the content-type mapping.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An open link added to the image branch of the edit form (today lines 62-64 render only a thumbnail there), passing 'image' like the detail/list screens
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Detail and list both give the image thumbnail a clickable openFile('image') link; the edit page is the one screen where the image branch has no open action, so a maintainer closing that gap would copy the detail template's call.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Upload-side rejection of image/svg+xml (isImage only checks file.type.startsWith('image/'), so SVG is accepted and stored with an executable type)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Both upload helpers do their own image check with startsWith('image/'); a maintainer hardening blob handling would plausibly tighten that same predicate, and the advisory's attack starts with an SVG upload.

O9_family: stored cross-site scripting (CWE-79): attacker-controlled MIME type passed into a same-origin blob: URL that is opened in a new window

O10_build.language: TypeScript generator (Node.js) that emits EJS templates for Angular/React/Vue applications
O10_build.toolchain: Node ^22.18.0 || >=24.11.0, npm >=10 (package.json:208-210); npm run build = tsc + copy-files; npm test = eslint + check-types + esmocha over test generators cli .blueprint lib (package.json:121-122), generation driven by yeoman-test
O10_build.project_tests: The generator's own specs only assert the generated file list, not template contents (generators/client/generators/common/__snapshots__/generator.spec.ts.snap:5-29); the behavioural assertions for this area live in generated-app spec templates, e.g. generators/angular/templates/src/main/webapp/app/core/util/data-util.service.spec.ts.ejs:40-51 (at the pinned commit it only asserts window.open was called once and never inspects the blob type) and generators/vue/templates/src/main/webapp/app/shared/data/data-utils.service.spec.ts.ejs:56-66, which need a generated app plus an npm install to run.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Downgrade only XML/SVG types (endsWith('+xml')) to application/octet-stream in the shared openFile — or only add 'image' at the image call sites — leaving text/html and other non-image types passed straight into new Blob; on the React side, swap the import to the local openFile but keep react-jhipster's (contentType, data) argument order, which feeds the base64 payload in as the MIME type.

out_of_scope_notes: The React frontend's pinned open path and the edit form's openActionLabel are implemented in the external npm package react-jhipster 1.0.3 (generators/react/resources/package.json:15); its source is not in this repository and was not read, so only the call sites here were screened.
unverified: Repo size in MB: no shell was available in this session, so O4.repo_mb is null and tiny_repo/giant_repo were judged from the tree's breadth only and left unflagged.

present_in_latest for both O8 routes: the candidate gives 'latest release: none' and only the pinned tree plus the fix diff were available, so presence in a later release could not be checked; the fix diff does not touch either route.

react-jhipster 1.0.3's openFile body and ValidatedField's openActionLabel behaviour could not be read (not vendored in the pinned tree); the claim that the React create/edit form still reaches an unfixed blob sink is inferred from the fix re-pointing React's detail/list imports away from that library and flipping the argument order (fix.diff:246-276).
O1 counted as the 8 generated screens the fix closes: Angular detail/list/edit, Vue detail/list/edit, React detail/list; the React create/edit screen is the O8 route and is not counted.

The affected behaviour is only exercised by generated-app vitest specs (.spec.ts.ejs templates); running them needs a generated app whose node_modules are installed at build time. No run was attempted, so offline_after_build is a judgement, not a measurement.

regression_tests_in_pinned_commit not flagged: the fix changes three existing spec templates (generators/angular/templates/src/main/webapp/app/core/util/data-util.service.spec.ts.ejs, generators/angular/templates/src/main/webapp/app/entities/_entityFolder_/detail/_entityFile_-detail.spec.ts.ejs, generators/vue/templates/src/main/webapp/app/shared/data/data-utils.service.spec.ts.ejs), but the new cases (image/png stays image/png, image/svg+xml and text/html become application/octet-stream) are not present at the pinned commit.
